title: Keep source access and security at the same computational power
statement: One classical LPN example implements the submitted-input source channel completely, and a Bell-pair use of a reusable near-optimal decoder gives an executable parity predictor. This is conditional on quantum hardness for quantum learners. The separately held random environment permits majority labels and ordinary elimination, returning the known parity correction with paid independently refreshed noise; it changes the joint source process.
